## Verification

Record exact commands, runtime versions, tested SHA, actual results and skipped checks.
Identify fixture tests, production-mode browser tests, real provider acceptance and
deployment separately. For database changes cover fresh migrations and supported upgrades.

## Release gates

List unresolved security, tenant isolation, HVAC-domain, migration, operational and
external evidence gates. Keep required acceptance blocked when evidence is absent.
An implementation reply or green suite does not close a finding or authorize merge/deployment.
